simone.comparison_to_published_oligoformer_auc: Not like-for-like: different model, cohort and experimental protocol; no superiority delta.
simone.cluster_bootstrap_caution: Only 6 transcript clusters; exploratory interval, not robust cross-gene validation.
simone.prior_delta_note: The tiny unrounded delta is rounding, not a changed prediction; all 322 paired scores match exactly.

allele_reporter.method: RNAduplex -T 37; exact PRIMARY TABLE reporter mismatch identities and secondary mismatches. Prior weakest-of-three method is not like-for-like.
allele_reporter.limitations: Reporter footprint reconstruction is not transcript/ClinVar/dbSNP/VEP verification; RNAduplex optimal local pairing may realign around a mismatch; thermodynamic margin is not cellular allele selectivity.

neuro.context: NO_REAL_FLANKS_N_PADDED_OUT_OF_DOMAIN; explicitly invalidates adapter length-only in_domain label. Not mathematically guaranteed to be a lower bound.

immune.comparison: NOT_LIKE_FOR_LIKE: stricter row exclusions, explicit pathogen exclusion and exact duplex deduplication; no rule tuning.
immune.limitations: Small heterogeneous assays; negative motif result does not establish immune safety; do not optimize immune-evasion sequences.
